title: Juicy Roasted Tunisian Chicken Pilaf
description: A high-protein Tunisian dish featuring roasted chicken, rice, and cheese, perfect for meal prep in a bento box. This recipe combines salty and cheesy flavors with a juicy roast.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear.
Combine the rice, chicken broth, olive oil, salt, and black pepper in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
In a large bowl, whisk together the harissa, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the harissa mixture.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 25 minutes or until cooked through.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Slice the roasted chicken and serve on top of the rice pilaf in a bento box.
